environment.description: Same binary deployed in a hardened Kubernetes pod with a custom AppArmor profile loaded via annotation container.apparmor.security.beta.kubernetes.io/app=localhost/k8s-auth-svc-restrict. The profile (installed at /etc/apparmor.d/k8s-auth-svc-restrict) specifies: deny /var/log/** rwklx, deny /tmp/** rwklx, deny /proc/*/mem r, with file rules allowing only /usr/lib/** r and /app/** r. Pod has memory limit of 64Mi with OOMKill enabled. Additionally, a NetworkPolicy restricts ingress to only the cluster-internal gateway on port 8080, and the gateway strips query parameters matching 'token' from non-allowlisted source IPs. The DEBUG_TOKEN is set to a 256-bit random value injected via Kubernetes Secret.

config.apparmor_rules: deny /var/log/** rwklx, deny /tmp/** rwklx, deny /proc/*/mem r, file /usr/lib/** r, file /app/** r
config.gateway_behavior: strips 'token' query param from external requests
